name: Pallid-winged Grasshopper
desc: Pallid-winged Grasshopper (Trimerotropis pallidipennis): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 19 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The pallid-winged grasshopper is a common grasshopper of the family Acrididae, native to the deserts of western North America along with South America, ranging from British Columbia to Argentina.
